mapper.sql: p.id, p.sku_id, p.hose_code, p.length_m, p.status, p.remark, p.location_id, l.location_code, l.location_name, s.nickname, s.inch, s.layer_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wms_hose_piece p LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = p.location_id LEFT JOIN wms_hose_spec s ON s.hose_code = p.hose_code WHERE p.status = '在库' AND p.hose_code = #{hoseCode} ORDER BY p.length_m

SELECT FROM wms_hose_piece p LEFT JOIN wms_location l ON l.id = p.location_id LEFT JOIN wms_hose_spec s ON s.hose_code = p.hose_code WHERE p.status = '在库'
AND (p.hose_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY CAST(SUBSTRING(p.hose_code, 1, 2) AS UNSIGNED), SUBSTRING(p.hose_code, 3, 2), p.length_m DESC
SELECT SUM(length_m) FROM wms_hose_piece WHERE sku_id = #{skuId} AND status = '在库'
mapper.update: UPDATE wms_inventory SET quantity = #{total} WHERE sku_id = #{skuId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wms_inventory (sku_id, warehouse_id, quantity) SELECT #{skuId}, w.id, #{total} FROM wms_warehouse w WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_inventory i WHERE i.sku_id = #{skuId}) ORDER BY w.id LIMIT 1
